inspected_anchors.finding: TMLE and iterative TMLE are distinct flags; setting both is rejected.

Stabilization and truncation occur only in internally generated IPWeights branch. Supplied IPWeights are checked for intervention attributes and used as supplied. Optional weights are explicitly rejected in the TMLE/iterative branch; do not generalize to every GCOMP path.

For max_iter>=1 with stopping unsatisfied, range1:(max_iter+1) and the nested else-if allow max_iter+1 updates. EIC_i_tplus is evaluated before an update and stored after the loop; at exhaustion its relation to final predictions needs native verification.
Initial update success flags and failed counts are assembled before the optional iterative fit. The returned risk/survival values are updated afterward, but that block does not recompute those flags.
TMLE influence components sum by subject ID; outer-product variance divides by unique-subject count squared. This does not establish validity for correlated subjects.
MSM score contributions aggregate by ID before sandwich outer products; not evidence that the same helper governs every estimator.
Survival and contrast helpers propagate influence curves and divide by nID squared; sign reversal does not change a scalar contrast variance.
Public interface forwards treatment, event, horizon, tol and maxIter to hazard estimator after input checking.
Mean route forwards no maxIter argument in this call; wrapper expects a fit with est/var/meanIC/ic fields.
Null/missing inputs, >2 treatment values and nonpositive times are rejected; hazard Gcomp request warns and proceeds with TMLE.

Every requested treatment/event pair must have an observed endpoint. The intended event-set guard compares unique(ftypeOfInterest) with itself, so ordinary nonmissing values cannot trigger it; no observed downstream failure claimed.
Horizon beyond observed endpoints yields method-specific extrapolation/constant-incidence warnings.
Early convergence failure returns a character sentinel.

Hazard fluctuations use ct<=maxIter before increment, allowing maxIter+1 updates under persistent residual; warn at exhaustion. Later colMeans call needs shape-specific tracing when only one influence column is selected.
Returns estimate, uncentered influence cross-product/n squared, meanIC and ic; default subject independence is not bank-cluster qualification.
Mean route sums temporal influence terms within each row, then uses uncentered cross-product/n squared and returns meanIC.
Censoring fitting subset depends on event/time boundary; no-observed-censoring branch sets G_dC=1.
SuperLearner path with bounds explicitly stops; no native trial performed.
fitTMLE is a fitSeqGcomp wrapper with TMLE=True.
